16	
17	/**
18	 * This class has to be created in onAttach() or onCreate().
19	 *
20	 * It contains registerForActivityResult calls and those
21	 * calls are only allowed before a fragment/activity is created.
22	 */
23	class SubscriptionsImportExportHelper(
24	    val fragment: Fragment
25	) {
26	    val context: Context = fragment.requireContext()
27	
28	    companion object {
29	        val TAG: String =
30	            SubscriptionsImportExportHelper::class.java.simpleName + "@" + Integer.toHexString(
31	                hashCode()
32	            )
33	    }
34	
35	    private val requestExportLauncher =
36	        fragment.registerForActivityResult(StartActivityForResult(), this::requestExportResult)
37	    private val requestImportLauncher =
38	        fragment.registerForActivityResult(StartActivityForResult(), this::requestImportResult)
39	
40	    private fun requestExportResult(result: ActivityResult) {
41	        val data = result.data?.data
42	        if (data != null && result.resultCode == Activity.RESULT_OK) {
43	            SubscriptionExportWorker.schedule(context, data)
44	        }
45	    }
46	
47	    private fun requestImportResult(result: ActivityResult) {
48	        val data = result.data?.dataString
49	        if (data != null && result.resultCode == Activity.RESULT_OK) {
50	            ImportConfirmationDialog.show(
51	                fragment,
52	                SubscriptionImportInput.PreviousExportMode(data)
53	            )
54	        }
55	    }
56	
57	    fun onExportSelected() {
58	        val date = SimpleDateFormat("yyyyMMddHHmm", Locale.ENGLISH).format(Date())
59	        val exportName = "newpipe_subscriptions_$date.json"
60	
61	        NoFileManagerSafeGuard.launchSafe(
62	            requestExportLauncher,
63	            StoredFileHelper.getNewPicker(
64	                context,
65	                exportName,
66	                JSON_MIME_TYPE,
67	                null
68	            ),
69	            TAG,
70	            context
71	        )
72	    }
73	
74	    fun onImportPreviousSelected() {
75	        NoFileManagerSafeGuard.launchSafe(
76	            requestImportLauncher,
77	            StoredFileHelper.getPicker(context, JSON_MIME_TYPE),
78	            TAG,
79	            context
80	        )
81	    }
82	}

6	package org.schabi.newpipe.local.playlist
7	
8	import android.app.Application
9	import android.util.Pair
10	import androidx.lifecycle.AndroidViewModel
11	import androidx.lifecycle.LiveData
12	import androidx.lifecycle.MutableLiveData
13	import io.reactivex.rxjava3.android.schedulers.AndroidSchedulers
14	import io.reactivex.rxjava3.core.Completable
15	import io.reactivex.rxjava3.disposables.CompositeDisposable
16	import io.reactivex.rxjava3.schedulers.Schedulers
17	import java.util.Collections
18	import org.schabi.newpipe.NewPipeDatabase
19	import org.schabi.newpipe.database.playlist.PlaylistStreamEntry
20	import org.schabi.newpipe.database.playlist.model.PlaylistEntity
21	import org.schabi.newpipe.local.history.HistoryRecordManager
22	
23	class LocalPlaylistViewModel(application: Application) : AndroidViewModel(application) {
24	    private val playlistManager = LocalPlaylistManager(NewPipeDatabase.getInstance(application))
25	    private val recordManager = HistoryRecordManager(application)
26	    private val disposables = CompositeDisposable()
27	
28	    private val _workState = MutableLiveData<WorkState>(WorkState.Idle)
29	    val workState: LiveData<WorkState> = _workState
30	
31	    sealed class WorkState {
32	        object Idle : WorkState()
33	        object Loading : WorkState()
34	        data class Error(val throwable: Throwable) : WorkState()
35	        object Success : WorkState()
36	    }
37	
38	    /**
39	     * Removes watched streams from the playlist.
40	     * This operation is performed in the background and survives fragment destruction
41	     * as it is not disposed when the ViewModel is cleared (to fix #8888).
42	     */
43	    fun removeWatchedStreams(playlistId: Long, removePartiallyWatched: Boolean) {
44	        _workState.value = WorkState.Loading
45	
46	        val historyIdsMaybe = recordManager.getStreamHistorySortedById()
47	            .firstElement()
48	            .map { historyList ->
49	                historyList.map { it.streamId }
50	            }
51	
52	        val streamsMaybe = playlistManager.getPlaylistStreams(playlistId)
53	            .firstElement()
54	            .zipWith(historyIdsMaybe) { playlist, historyStreamIds ->
55	                val itemsToKeep = mutableListOf<PlaylistStreamEntry>()
56	                val isThumbnailPermanent = playlistManager.getIsPlaylistThumbnailPermanent(playlistId)
57	                var thumbnailVideoRemoved = false
58	
59	                val streamStates = recordManager.loadLocalStreamStateBatch(playlist).blockingGet()
60	
61	                for (i in playlist.indices) {
62	                    val playlistItem = playlist[i]
63	                    val streamStateEntity = streamStates[i]
64	                    val indexInHistory = Collections.binarySearch(historyStreamIds, playlistItem.streamId)
65	                    val duration = playlistItem.toStreamInfoItem().duration
66	
67	                    if (indexInHistory < 0 || streamStateEntity == null ||
68	                        (!removePartiallyWatched && !streamStateEntity.isFinished(duration))
69	                    ) {
70	                        itemsToKeep.add(playlistItem)
71	                    } else if (!isThumbnailPermanent && !thumbnailVideoRemoved &&
72	                        playlistManager.getPlaylistThumbnailStreamId(playlistId) ==
73	                        playlistItem.streamEntity.uid
74	                    ) {
75	                        thumbnailVideoRemoved = true
76	                    }
77	                }
78	
79	                Pair(itemsToKeep, thumbnailVideoRemoved)
80	            }
81	
82	        val disposable = streamsMaybe
83	            .subscribeOn(Schedulers.io())
84	            .flatMapCompletable { flow ->
85	                val itemsToKeep = flow.first
86	                val thumbnailVideoRemoved = flow.second
87	                val streamIds = itemsToKeep.map { it.streamId }
88	
89	                playlistManager.updateJoin(playlistId, streamIds)
90	                    .andThen(
91	                        Completable.fromAction {
92	                            if (thumbnailVideoRemoved) {
93	                                updateThumbnailUrl(playlistId, itemsToKeep)
94	                            }
95	                        }
96	                    )
97	            }
98	            .observeOn(AndroidSchedulers.mainThread())
99	            .subscribe(
100	                { _workState.value = WorkState.Success },
101	                { _workState.value = WorkState.Error(it) }
102	            )
103	
104	        disposables.add(disposable)
105	    }
106	
107	    /**
108	     * Removes duplicate streams from the playlist.
109	     */
110	    fun removeDuplicates(playlistId: Long) {
111	        _workState.value = WorkState.Loading
112	
113	        val disposable = playlistManager.getDistinctPlaylistStreams(playlistId)
114	            .firstElement()
115	            .subscribeOn(Schedulers.io())
116	            .flatMapCompletable { itemsToKeep ->
117	                val streamIds = itemsToKeep.map { it.streamId }
118	                playlistManager.updateJoin(playlistId, streamIds)
119	            }
120	            .observeOn(AndroidSchedulers.mainThread())
121	            .subscribe(
122	                { _workState.value = WorkState.Success },
123	                { _workState.value = WorkState.Error(it) }
124	            )
125	
126	        disposables.add(disposable)
127	    }
128	
129	    private fun updateThumbnailUrl(playlistId: Long, itemsToKeep: List<PlaylistStreamEntry>) {
130	        if (playlistManager.getIsPlaylistThumbnailPermanent(playlistId)) {
131	            return
132	        }
133	
134	        val thumbnailStreamId = if (itemsToKeep.isNotEmpty()) {
135	            itemsToKeep[0].streamEntity.uid
136	        } else {
137	            PlaylistEntity.DEFAULT_THUMBNAIL_ID
138	        }
139	
140	        playlistManager.changePlaylistThumbnail(playlistId, thumbnailStreamId, false).blockingGet()
141	    }
142	
143	    override fun onCleared() {
144	        super.onCleared()
145	        // We deliberately do not clear disposables here to allow pending
146	        // database mutations to finish even if the user leaves the screen.
147	    }
148	}

Several good targets:
- `LocalPlaylistViewModel.kt`: `object` singletons → `data object`; `[0]` → `firstOrNull()?.…`; `android.util.Pair` → Kotlin `Pair`; `Collections.binarySearch` → stdlib `binarySearch`
- `RemotePlaylistManager.kt`: inline single-use `playlist` variable in `onBookmark`
- `ChannelItem.kt`: eliminate `var details` mutation in `getDetailLine`

Committed as `fce7c8d6c`. Three files improved:

- **`LocalPlaylistViewModel.kt`**: `object Idle/Loading/Success` → `data object`; replaced `android.util.Pair` and `java.util.Collections` imports with Kotlin-native `to`/destructuring and `List.binarySearch`; `itemsToKeep[0]` → `itemsToKeep.firstOrNull()?.streamEntity?.uid ?: DEFAULT_THUMBNAIL_ID`.
- **`RemotePlaylistManager.kt`**: inlined the single-use `playlist` variable in `onBookmark` — the constructor call can be passed directly to `upsert`.
